ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark vertical streaks and mottled clusters present on both lobes; significant low-intensity dark pigmentation on the lateral-most edge of the right lobe; yellowish-brown pixel region on the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations with high pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks and valleys) visible across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curvature on the outer margins of both lobes, resulting in tapered, sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular and oval-shaped pixel clusters ranging from 5-20 pixels in diameter distributed across the central white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical and diagonal dark linear marks (rake marks) that interrupt the primary high-intensity pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge topography suggesting historical tissue loss or heavy wear; yellowish-brown lesion or staining on the lower right lobe near the water surface interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy dark pigmentation border localized to the outer lateral margin of the right lobe.
